view.scene_description: A modern, well-lit bookstore or library interior featuring extensive wooden bookshelves filled with books. A prominent spiral tower of shelves rises in the center. People are seated at tables or standing, engaged in reading or conversation. Warm lighting illuminates the space, creating an inviting atmosphere.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf tower
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical structure with multiple circular shelves, each holding books. It is centrally located, illuminated by bright lights around its perimeter. The shelves ascend toward the ceiling, appearing to float slightly due to lighting effects.

objects.label: wooden wall-mounted bookshelves
objects.observation: Large, multi-tiered shelves built into the walls, filled with rows of books. They extend across the background, with warm under-lighting highlighting the spines. Arched alcoves with small desks are integrated into the shelving unit.

objects.label: person wearing white hoodie
objects.observation: A young man with glasses, standing on the right side of the frame. He wears a white hoodie with a cartoon character on it and holds a phone. He appears to be looking toward the camera or slightly off-frame.

objects.label: orange chairs
objects.observation: Several curved, modern-style orange chairs arranged in a cluster near the foreground. Some are occupied by people, while others are empty. Their smooth, rounded backs face inward, suggesting a communal seating area.

objects.label: people seated at tables
objects.observation: Multiple individuals are seated at small tables, focused on reading or writing. One person is leaning over a notebook, another is looking down at a device. They are positioned between the orange chairs and the spiral shelf.

objects.label: arched alcove workstations
objects.observation: Wooden-framed alcoves with small desks and stools, embedded within the wall shelves. Each has a lamp above and appears to be for individual study or work. One person is seated at such a station.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Circular, recessed ceiling lights provide ambient illumination. One large, bright circular light is centered above the main shelving area, casting a soft glow downward.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000023", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
